consequence.statement: Query results for stats, volume, label, and series requests will now be cached by default to the in-memory results_cache, changing query performance characteristics and memory usage patterns.

original.statement: Results caching for 'stats', 'volume', 'label', and 'series' queries in the TSDB index type is now enabled by default, caching to the results_cache configured in the query_range config section using an in-memory cache by default.

decision.reason: [ev-959df790f1d4] says results caching for 'stats', 'volume', 'label' and 'series' queries is now on by default. These results go to the `results_cache` in `query_range`, which uses an in-memory cache by default. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. The statement's note about memory and performance follows from more queries now being cached in memory by default.
